Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil lights a diya.]

Nikhil (excited): "Careful!"

[Nikhil paints a picture.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Nikhil (excited): "That's great!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Nikhil (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil trips over a stone and falls.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Kavita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Kavita (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Kavita: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Kavita (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
